name: Banana Pepper
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as peppers are naturally low FODMAP and don't contain fermentable carbohydrates that feed bacteria.
preparationTips: Remove seeds and membranes to reduce any potential digestive irritation
Roasting or grilling can enhance sweetness and make them easier to digest
Start with smaller portions if you have capsaicin sensitivity
Fresh banana peppers are milder than pickled varieties
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C for immune support
Good source of vitamin A for eye health
Low in calories and high in water content
